name: Socketbarrage
description: Aim the point at the seam between two plates and thrust to slip it through.

name: Ironthrust
description: Punch the point through layered cloth and padding with a sharp drive from the rear hand.

name: Unflinching Collarband
description: Set the feet and haft against an armoured rush so the shaft turns the blow aside.

name: Mayhem Beatback
description: Hook the blade's base under an armour rim and pull to open the guard.

name: Nova Longshaft
description: Place the point in the gap above the breastplate and thrust with a narrow stream of qi.

name: Spearbarrage
description: Press the point on a rivet line and feed qi down the shaft until the plate gives.

name: Surging Leafhead
description: Slide off an armoured opponent's shove with a step that strips the force from it.

name: Pointbarrage
description: Narrow the qi in the leaf-blade into a hard needle and drive it through thick armour.

name: Twirlthrash
description: Strike the guard with the haft, hook it aside and thrust the point through the gap in one drive.

name: Torrent Spearpoint
description: Pivot in place with the point held low to keep every approach to the body covered.

name: Splitting Stretch
description: Prick the nearest opponent at the ring's edge, then step out of line before others can answer.

name: Equipoise Heelspike
description: Check an opponent beside the body with the haft's end while the point faces the front.

name: Racing Ferrule
description: Retreat in a curving step that places one opponent between the body and the others.

name: Chimespear
description: Choke up on the shaft and shoulder through a gap, pressing a weak opponent aside.

name: Raging Slideshaft
description: Turn through a full circle with the shaft held out so the haft strikes outward in every direction.

name: Intentsocket
description: Lunge at the weakest opponent, withdraw, and lunge at the next in a chosen order.

name: Bladewings Thrash
description: Thrust the butt backward past the hip into an opponent who has circled behind.

name: Dismantling Buttshoe
description: Sweep the whole shaft in one great arc that strikes and drives back all within the spear's reach.

name: Shadethrust
description: Weave the point from face to face of several opponents to freeze each in place as it threatens.

name: Skinning Slideshaft
description: Whirl the shaft out in a strike and carry it home along the same circle to guard.

name: Twirlassault
description: Lead with the butt in a whirl that comes round into a thrust at the chest.

name: Bladewings Cloak
description: Loosen the wrists and spin the shaft so each blow is carried off the body by the wood.

name: Buttshoe Leap
description: Turn through a spiral step that places the body outside an attacker's line.

name: Ironpoint
description: Strike with the shaft on the outward whirl and again with the point on its return.

name: Stifling Collarband
description: Catch an opposing blade within the whirl and draw it wide of the body.

name: Lotpoint
description: Chain three whirls with a different point of contact each time in a single unbroken circle.

name: Ferrule Barrage
description: Spin the leaf-blade's edge around in a bright wheel that cuts at any who press close.

name: Rumble Leafhead
description: Thrust with the shaft wholly filled by the qi field so the point lands with the body's full weight.

name: Renewing Bindcord
description: Extend the field a hand beyond the point and feel for the opponent's stance through it.

name: Longshaft Greave
description: Anchor the guard in the field so a heavy blow meets the shaft and does not shift the stance.

name: Granite Spearpoint
description: Shed the field around the legs to glide the body across a gap of several paces.

name: Rupturing Stretch
description: Draw the field down to a thin stream at the point and jab through a narrow opening.

name: Crippling Pushthrough
description: Widen the field around the shaft to press on the opposing weapon from a hand's breadth away.

name: Tiered Beatback
description: Link three thrusts along lines guided by the field's reading of the opponent's guard.

name: Nova Heelspike
description: Fill the shaft to the brim with qi and release it all in a single piercing jab.

name: Granite Buttshoe
description: Raise the field's edge along the shaft to shove an incoming blade away from the body.

name: Scything Nova Pushthrough
description: Fill the whole line before the point with qi so a single thrust cuts through layered defences.

name: Thorn Ferrule
description: Spin the shaft inside a dome of the qi field to turn away every blow aimed at the body.

name: Rumble Spearpoint
description: Extend a hand of qi beyond the point and jab so the strike lands past the metal.

name: Might Heelspike
description: Trace a line along the opponent's guard with the extended tip to test its strength.

name: Unbroken Bindcord
description: Parry with the extended field at its edge, away from the body.

name: Spearspurt
description: Pull the extended qi back into the shaft as the body steps clear.

name: Rumble Pushthrough
description: Lengthen the qi at the point by stages through a thrust so the reach grows as it travels.

name: Suppressing Longshaft
description: Curve the extended tip around an opposing shaft and drag it from its owner's line.

name: Fortifying Leafhead
description: Send the extended tip against several targets in turn and read each guard through the shaft.

name: Twirltorment
description: Extend the qi a full arm's length beyond the point and skewer a distant target in one thrust.

name: Intertwined Beatback
description: Strike once with the metal and again with the extended qi, landing two blows from different distances.

name: Granite Slideshaft
description: Begin with the hands and feet moving in two tracks that meet in a thrust at the centre.

name: Granite Bladewings
description: Flick the point forward with the wrists like a springing reed to strike at the face.

name: Siltsocket
description: Retreat with the two feet crossing and parting in a regular pair of steps.

name: Annealed Collarband
description: Slide both hands apart along the shaft to turn a blow off the body.

name: Murk Collarband
description: Circle the point around the body's rim to turn aside any of several approaching thrusts.

name: Thrustassault
description: Link two thrusts, first from the lead hand and then the rear, in one extension.

name: Manacling Stretch
description: Let the shaft flow along an opposing haft like a river along a bank and steer it aside.

name: Gust Bindcord
description: Prick the shoulder and thigh of the same opponent in close succession from one stance.

name: Thrustbarrage
description: Send a wave of paired thrusts, each following the last, to press the opponent back step by step.

name: Pushthrough Thrash
description: Draw the opponent into the open, parry, step and thrust again on the return.

name: Chime Longshaft
description: Hold the point high and still like a perched hawk, ready to drop on an opening.

name: Granite Heelspike
description: Drop the point from above in a sudden descending jab at the shoulder.

name: Glancing Beatback
description: Step up and forward in a rising line to bring the point above the opponent's guard.

name: Torrent Leafhead
description: Spread the hands wide on the shaft to catch a broad cut with both ends.

name: Thorn Bladewings
description: Hook the leaf-blade's base around an opposing weapon like a talon and pull it free.

name: Verity Ferrule
description: Fix the eyes on the opponent's guard hand and read the distance before the stoop begins.

name: Spearpoint Barrage
description: Rise from a crouch under a cut and thrust upward into the attacker's lower chest.

name: Furrowing Stretch
description: Drop the point toward a target then swerve it sideways to cut across the throat line.

name: Alternating Buttshoe
description: Strike from above, withdraw upward, and strike again at a different line in two passes.

name: Subduing Slideshaft
description: Lift the shaft sharply upward under an opposing haft to throw its owner off balance.

name: Beatback Onslaught
description: Plunge the point down from a leap's height into the target with the body's whole weight behind it.

name: Aegis Heelspike
description: Spin the shaft overhead and descend behind it so the screen shields the body to the landing.

name: Spearthrash
description: Send one stream of qi straight along the shaft and one curving round it as the point thrusts.

name: Adamant Bladewings
description: Sink into a low stance with the point trailing and deflect blows over the shaft.

name: Socketcuirass
description: Curl the shaft around an opposing haft in a river's bend and press the weapon out wide.

name: Pointleap
description: Spin the body in an eddy-step that sweeps the stance clear of a straight attack.

name: Immovable Bindcord
description: Parry across the middle of the current with qi flowing in a loop around the shaft.

name: Scalding Buttshoe
description: Guide the thrust between two opposing guards as a river runs between banks.

name: Doctrine Slideshaft
description: Press the opponent back with a chain of thrusts that fill the open space as water fills a basin.

name: Glinttwirl
description: Curve a thrust around a raised guard in a bending arc and pierce the open flank.

name: Pointassault
description: Drive two surging streams of qi alternately through the shaft in successive blows on the opponents ahead.

name: Blaze Stretch
description: Run the hard current through the shaft for a thrust that does not yield.

name: Murk Ferrule
description: Run the soft current through the shaft so a parry yields and turns the blow away.

name: Torrent Pushthrough
description: Switch the grip and current together while stepping so the stance changes hard to soft.

name: Keen Leafhead
description: Hold both currents at the point and feel which holds the better reading of the opponent's guard.

name: Ravaging Longshaft
description: Cross the two currents in the point at the moment of impact for a sharply piercing strike.

name: Implacable Spearpoint
description: Weave the shaft in two layers, soft outside and hard within, to catch and turn heavy blows.

name: Chime Collarband
description: Split an opposing weapon's line with the hard current and drive the yielding current into the gap.

name: Successive Leafhead
description: Join a hard thrust, a yielding parry and a final press into one closing sequence.

name: Hardened Buttshoe
description: Take a wide-footed stance on open ground, the shaft angled so the body's bearing is never lost.

name: Socketassault
description: Thrust on a slant across the line of the wind, using the pressure to steady the point.

name: Longshaft Leap
description: Time a quick step forward to the push of a gust so the stride carries a pace further.

name: Torrent Heelspike
description: Raise the shaft to the windward side to meet an incoming blow before it gathers weight.

name: Trouncing Collarband
description: Lean into a lunge with the body's weight forward like a tree leaning in a gale.

name: Rumble Slideshaft
description: Beat sharply across an opposing haft so it shears away from the line of its thrust.

name: Thrusttorment
description: Hold the point on its bearing and jab short at the opponent's guard hand.

name: Staunch Charter Bindcord
description: Stand at an imagined edge with the shaft held to deflect any push that would move the body.

name: Doctrine Bladewings
description: Join three spaced thrusts to the rhythm of the wind into one combination that wears down a guard.

name: Tearing Beatback
description: Thrust along the sworn line and hold the point on it even as the opponent pushes.

name: Silt Ferrule
description: Run a long stride on level ground and drive the point forward as the final foot lands.

name: Equipoise Bindcord
description: Plant the feet and parry without moving them, keeping faith with the line held.

name: Granite Stretch
description: Draw the leaf-blade's edge along the opponent's forearm like wind scouring a ridge.

name: Silt Spearpoint
description: Advance slowly along a fixed bearing, with the point checking every attempt to step across.

name: Gust Bladewings
description: Pivot on the lead foot with the point guarding the open side at the edge of the stance.

name: Spearassault
description: Hold the oath-line through an opponent's counter and press the point in as the counter spends itself.

name: Hour Pushthrough
description: Drop the shaft from overhead with the weight of a gale-bent branch onto the opponent's guard.

name: Chime Buttshoe
description: Wedge the lead foot behind the opponent's heel while the shaft pins the chest and tips the stance.

name: Aegis Longshaft
description: Rise from a knee under a blow with the shaft braced over the head and the oath unbroken.

name: Facettwirl
description: Gather the whole body behind the sworn line and drive the point through the guard in one move.

name: Speartorment
description: Hold two sworn lines, one high and one low, and strike each in turn without breaking either.

name: Pointtorment
description: Send the field along the shaft in one long gust so the point drives without a pause.

name: Verity Collarband
description: Spread the field on the open air and read the opponent's motions by the disturbance on it.

name: Gust Heelspike
description: Brace the shaft with the field on its bearing so an impact slides along it unspent.

name: Gust Spearpoint
description: Glide across the ground on the field's push to arrive at the opponent's flank.

name: Stretch Onslaught
description: Narrow the field to a hard, fast gale stream and pierce through the opponent's guard.

name: Bindcord Cloak
description: Lash the shaft through open air with a roaring field to press on the weapons within reach.

name: Facet Leafhead
description: Cleave a straight line of qi before the point and thrust through its centre in one driving move.

name: Drubbing Slideshaft
description: Sweep the field out in a great arc so the gale scatters all who stand in the spear's reach.

name: Sockettorment
description: Thrust along the sworn bearing with the field bound to it so the point cannot be turned.

name: Torrent Ferrule
description: Step with the push of the plateau wind to close a gap in a single stride.

name: Mantled Socket
description: Fix the shaft along its bearing so strikes slide away without shifting the line.

name: Buttshoe Tincture
description: Anchor the stance in the field and feel the ground's slope and the wind's push.

name: Wrecking Thrust
description: Let the shaft fall in a long hammering stroke that bears on the opponent's guard.

name: Twirlbarrage
description: Chain three thrusts along the sworn bearing with the field growing denser at each.

name: Gyve Pushthrough
description: Bind the opposing haft in the gust of the field and cast it away to the side.

name: Enduring Bindcord
description: Hold the shaft across the front in a screen the field thickens against the oncoming wind of blows.

name: Thrustthrash
description: Plant the feet on the sworn line and drive the point through the target with the whole field.

name: Toxintwirl
description: Break the opponent's own bearing with a beat on the haft and thrust through the gap.
